summary: Iteration 3 verified 4 new features: (1) GET /api/host/insights returns 9 months with keys key/month/nights/earnings/occupancy — host 200, guest 403; a confirmed booking (2 nights) increments the check-in month's nights by 2 and earnings by amount_due. (2) GET /api/bookings/{id}/receipt.pdf returns application/pdf starting with %PDF for owner and host, 404 for another guest. (3) PUT /api/host/listing filters instagram_posts to only https://www.instagram.com/ URLs (evil.com stripped); description/amenities/house_rules unchanged; listing restored to [] afterwards. (4) Frontend Home shows instagram-section with insta-posts-link (…/Nestavia_stays/), insta-reels-link (…/reels/), insta-profile-card, insta-empty when no posts; after host saves an instagram URL via listing-instagram-input + save-listing-btn, home renders insta-embed with iframe src ending /embed; reverted. (5) Home enquiry-section: name/dates/guests=3/question → enquiry-whatsapp-btn href contains wa.me/918802757866 + URL-encoded 'John Tester', 'Guests%3A%203', question text. (6) Host dashboard: occupancy-insights renders with recharts SVG, insights-total-nights + insights-total-earnings, three insight-month-* tiles. (7) Guest /my-bookings: download-receipt-btn-{id} click yields network response 200 application/pdf %PDF. (8) Regression: quote-total renders; mobile 390px home has 0px horizontal overflow.

action_items: (Low) Investigate React hydration warning about <span> child of <option> element seen on home page. Non-blocking — but should be fixed for a clean console.

(Low, recharts warning) OccupancyInsights emits 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first paint — chart still renders but consider giving ResponsiveContainer an explicit min height or check parent layout timing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py host_insights: per_night = paid / (nights) means for 'confirmed' bookings we distribute amount_due (down-payment) across nights, but the spec says earnings should grow by amount_due for the CHECK-IN month specifically. Because bookings that span multiple months would have their amount_due split across months, this works correctly ONLY when the booking is entirely within one month (which is the case for 2-night bookings inside the checked month). Note this as a nuance for multi-month stays.
server.py booking_receipt: builds a synchronous PDF via reportlab in the request thread — acceptable for MVP but consider offloading if load rises.

InstagramGallery.jsx uses posts.slice(0,6).map + `${u.replace(/\/?(\?.*)?$/, "")}/embed` — regex is fragile for URLs already containing '/embed' or query strings. Simple trailing-slash normalization would be clearer.
ListingEditor split('\n') for instagram_posts is fine but empty lines become empty strings; backend already trims — acceptable.
